visualReview.notes: Science Museum complete connected parent exterior: giant Ionic-columned pale stone Exhibition Road front, fourteen tapered shafts with real upper recess depth/open gaps and simplified capitals, paired tall glazing, stepped cornice/parapet and three real lower entrance recesses with wooden doors, soffits and thresholds. Three sets of 4/3/2 supported treads bridge local grades. The model continues through the long brick gallery range to the western modern/glazed block with picture-led clerestory/roof lanterns and plant volumes. Two ordinary exterior pictures and standard PMTiles/Mapzen guided one continuous author/inspect/fix pass. A front camera blocked by a building across Exhibition Road was moved into the street. Adjacent north buildings and Natural History Museum stay independent. No copied banners/lettering, furnished galleries, objects/vehicles or adjacent green barrel-roof mass.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Seven roles share six existing 256px graphs: stone_limestone (wall/trim variants), brick, membrane, storefront, metal_painted and wood_plain. Canonical metric UVs, sRGB-to-linear tint and graph means baked for skyline. Seven textured draws/one skyline; no embedded image, private atlas or new graph. Separate POSITION/NORMAL streams and equal CPU/GPU geometry accounting. Each used graph reads once, and unload disposes all model geometry. Flat portable/shared/synthetic planes intersect native-grade foundations or partly bury outer stair treads; actual native ground supplies fit.

mediumFiReview.notes: Four authored LODs 949 / 3117 / 12461 / 39285 triangles; initial skyline+district geometry 377224 bytes, closeup 3767080 bytes. Six GLBs zero Khronos errors/warnings; 396 actual mesh/contact probes; 15 actual PMTiles13/14/15 cases including two detailed fragments of the one owned parent. Inspected 52 current source/shared/medium-fi/native frames. Skyline keeps all fourteen shafts, three entry tread sets and complete connected massing; closeup adds volutes, individual window-frame bars, door panel trim and roof details. All levels preserve 2108 resident/2724 wider independent buildings, original 201x201/6m ground/roads and 329.595m² water. Failure retains all 2,109 originals; every run restores ground/water with zero live geometry. Flat review planes and synthetic neighbors are style context; native original terrain establishes site fit. The very wide frontal detail crops outer cornice edges in some portable/shared frames; turntables, whole-site and native entrance views cover the envelope.

limitations: Science Museum connected exterior on its actual long mapped footprint: giant Ionic-columned pale stone Exhibition Road frontage and three real recessed lower entrances, stepped cornice/parapet, repeated tall paired-level glazing, rear clerestory/flat roof blocks, long red-brick gallery range with restrained roof lanterns and western modern grey/glazed block. Source silhouette follows the complete mapped east-to-west museum, not only its street facade. Adjacent north mapped buildings, Natural History Museum, separate links and Imperial College remain independent. No copied lettering, temporary banners, furnished galleries, vehicles/art collections or neighboring green barrel-roof building.
